title: Desert car chase
idea: a vintage muscle car races across a desert road chased by a dust cloud
style: 70s road movie, bleached highlights, heavy 35mm grain, slight halation
subject: a dusty black 1970 muscle car with chrome bumpers, driver barely visible through the glare
setting: a straight two-lane desert highway at midday, heat shimmer, mesas on the horizon
lens: 200mm telephoto for the opening, compressed background
light: hard midday sun from directly above, deep black shadows under the car, heat shimmer on the road

beats.action: the car approaches head-on through heat shimmer, a dust cloud rising behind it
beats.camera: locked-off low angle on the road, telephoto

beats.action: the car roars past the camera, dust and gravel spraying
the car from the side at speed, the mesas sliding by
beats.camera: tracking shot alongside at wheel height

beats.action: the driver's hand shifts gear; the car lurches forward
beats.camera: cut to an interior over-the-shoulder shot

beats.action: the car shrinks into the distance, the dust settles on the empty road

physics: the car squats under acceleration and leans in the pass; wheels spin with motion blur; dust and gravel are thrown backwards and settle slowly; heat shimmer distorts the far road

sound.fx: V8 engine roar building and passing, gravel spray, a gear change

notes: Multi-shot on purpose: Kling 3.0 follows the cut at 6 s. On single-shot models (Veo, Wan, Runway) the check command warns about beat 4; drop the interior beat for those. 21:9 would suit the genre, but Kling offers 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1.
